title: Portuguese-Style Braised Cabbage Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew made with tender cabbage, smoked sausage, and a rich, flavorful broth.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add cabbage and cook until slightly tender, about 5 minutes.
Add stew, sausage, broth, and tomato paste.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Braise for 30 minutes, or until cabbage is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
